verdict.rationale: Rive's first-party docs say the Rive Editor can be connected to AI tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol). They describe a first set of tools for creating View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes, and a probe confirms an official MCP page exists. Missing for 10: setup and connection details (transport, auth, supported clients), a full tool catalog beyond the 'first set', and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
